reason: Sec. 1-101 suspended the listed Title 10 provisions only for the period beginning on September 15, 1978 and ending on September 30, 1979. The command therefore ended under the order's own terms on 1979-09-30, recorded inclusive (the exclusive reading is that it ends when that day begins, 1979-10-01). EO 12239 (1980-09-21) later revoked EO 12082 by name (formal disposition, after the order had expired); it is recorded as a later event and is not the first end. No earlier end appears in the held corpus.
inventory_reason: Section 1-101 as a whole: suspension, for a stated period, of five Title 10 provisions (items (a) to (e)). The dossier split the section into items without the period language, and its eight rows duplicated section 1-102; the five items share one period and one command, so they are one clause here.

reason: Sec. 1-102 made the listed Title 10 disability-separation conditions effective only for the period beginning on September 15, 1978 and ending on September 30, 1979. The command ended under the order's own terms on 1979-09-30, recorded inclusive (the exclusive reading is 1979-10-01). EO 12239 sec. 1-102 later states a period from September 15, 1978 to September 30, 1982, but that is EO 12239's own command and does not extend this order. EO 12239 (1980-09-21) later revoked EO 12082 by name (formal disposition, after the order had expired); it is recorded as a later event and is not the first end. No earlier end appears in the held corpus.
inventory_reason: Section 1-102 as a whole: for a stated period, three disability separation conditions of Title 10 are effective (items (a) to (c)). The dossier rows a-dup2, b-dup2 and c-dup2 are this section split into items; one clause here.

reason: Sec. 1-103 is a one-time revocation of EOs 10616, 11151, 11437 and 11554, as amended; the text (are hereby revoked.) operates on issuance with no period or condition, so the command was performed and exhausted on signing, 1978-09-19. The effective date is the signing date (the order says nothing later; it was filed September 20 and printed September 21, 1978, and a later effective date would not change the whole-order end). The revoked orders stay revoked; EO 12239's revocation of EO 12082 does not revive them.
inventory_reason: Section 1-103, the revocation of Executive Orders 10616, 11151, 11437 and 11554 as amended. The dossier inventory omitted it although it is an operative command.
